question: Is the Tenergy T320 power station worth buying? Where's the best place to buy it?
query: Tenergy T320 power station review price buy 2026

replays.text:
**The Tenergy T320 is worth considering if you need a compact station for low-power devices—not if you want to run appliances or power tools.**

It has a 300Wh LiFePO₄ battery, weighs 8.1 lb, and offers USB-C PD up to 45W, USB-A, DC ports, and two AC outlets. The key limitation is **200W continuous AC output** (400W surge); Tenergy specifically says it’s not recommended for things like heaters, kettles, coffee makers, hair dryers, or power tools. It also comes with a two-year warranty. ([Tenergy T320 specs and listing](https://power.tenergy.com/tenergy-t320-portable-power-station-300wh-battery-110v-200w-surge-400w-two-pure-sine-wave-ac-outputs-usb-type-c-pd-45w-solar-ready-mobile-power-for-outdoors-camping-vans-rv-hunting-emergency-backup/))

**Best place to buy: Tenergy’s own store**, which lists it at **$225.99**, in stock with free shipping. That’s a substantial discount from the listed $299.99 regular price, and the product page gives the clearest specs and warranty terms. ([Buy from Tenergy](https://power.tenergy.com/tenergy-t320-portable-power-station-300wh-battery-110v-200w-surge-400w-two-pure-sine-wave-ac-outputs-usb-type-c-pd-45w-solar-ready-mobile-power-for-outdoors-camping-vans-rv-hunting-emergency-backup/))

**The Tenergy T320 is worth considering for light-duty use**, especially camping, phones, tablets, a laptop, lights, or modest emergency backup. Its 300Wh LiFePO₄ battery, 45W USB-C port, two AC outlets, and 8.1 lb weight make it a handy compact option. Tenergy lists it for **$225.99, down from $299.99**, with free shipping and a two-year warranty ([Tenergy product page](https://power.tenergy.com/tenergy-t320-portable-power-station-300wh-battery-110v-200w-surge-400w-two-pure-sine-wave-ac-outputs-usb-type-c-pd-45w-solar-ready-mobile-power-for-outdoors-camping-vans-rv-hunting-emergency-backup/)).
